newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Generali opens office in China.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Generali opens office in China.

text.p: Italian insurance group Assicurazioni Generali said on Thursday it had received permission to open a representative office in China as a first step towards obtaining a license to do business in the country.

Generali said in a statement that the new office, to be located in the China World Trade Centre, would gather information on the local insurance market and seek to identify possible joint venture partners.
Over the past 15 years Generali has stepped up business ties with the People's Insurance Company of China (PICC), which has provided cover for Generali clients with interests in China.
The PICC accounts for 80 percent of total premium business in China of around $7 billion, the statement said.
Generali said the Chinese required foreign companies to operate a representative office for at least two years before applying for a license to do business.
The statement said China had recently issued business licenses to eight local insurance companies and a number of foreign companies.
